test_title: PYST 53: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Do you believe that you __have a possibility__ of getting that job?
solution: The correct answer is Option 3) i.e. "stand a chance". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"stand a chance"** means to have a possibility of achieving or getting something. (कुछ प्राप्त करने या प्राप्त करने की संभावना होना) • **Example**: Even though the competition was tough, she believed she stood a chance to win the award. • It clearly justifies the meaning of the sentence. Therefore, the correct answer is- **"stand a chance".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Spill the beans **- This idiom means to reveal secret information accidentally or deliberately. (गुप्त जानकारी को गलती से या जानबूझकर प्रकट करना।) • **Example**: Finally, he spilled the beans about their surprise party plans. • **Snow job** - It refers to an attempt to deceive or persuade by using flattery or lies.(चापलूसी या झूठ का उपयोग करके धोखा देने या मनाने का प्रयास।) • **Example**: The salesman did such a snow job on us that we ended up buying things we didn't need. • **Shoot the breeze** - This means to engage in casual or inconsequential conversation.(आकस्मिक या अप्रासंगिक बातचीत में शामिल होना।) • **Example**: We sat in the café for hours just shooting the breeze. 3d:T859, The correct answer is option (1) i.e. "**Annoy**".
